title: A rapid whose wheel track crosses an earlier slot
rationale: Both cuts are forced to C = 90, so the link is a pure translation from (1800, 600) to (1200, 880) and both pivots give it. The left wheel, 205 mm below the tool, is dragged across the 1200 mm slot at about x = 1412 (safety-model 9.1: a translation is checked like a cut piece).
